svg.title: From text to context-aware token vectors
svg.desc: Text is tokenized, converted to token IDs, mapped to learned embedding vectors with position information, and processed by repeated Transformer blocks. The output is one context-aware vector per token; the task head determines whether the model classifies, scores, pools, or predicts vocabulary tokens.

g.text: Running example: treat each word as one token for this illustration.
[red, running, shoes] → token IDs [17, 42, 91] · illustrative IDs
Each ID selects a learned vector; position information marks its place.
Attention mixes tokens; feed-forward networks transform their features.
5 · Contextual vectors and a task head
One vector per token → classify, pool, score, or predict vocabulary tokens
Token IDs identify vocabulary entries. They are not semantic scores or vector coordinates.
